About us

Legal expertise grounded in integrity and precision.

Arkad & Associates is a law firm dedicated to providing comprehensive legal services through considered legal advice, diligent preparation and effective representation. We recognise that every legal matter involves distinct facts, circumstances and objectives, and accordingly approach each matter with due care, professional responsibility and attention to detail.

Our approach
Integrity

At Arkad & Associates, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of professional ethics, integrity and confidentiality while delivering diligent, objective and client-focused legal services.

Preparation

Our approach is founded on sound legal principles, thorough examination of facts and documents, practical legal strategies and a clear understanding of the remedies available under the law.

Beyond dispute resolution

We believe that effective legal practice extends beyond dispute resolution. It involves identifying legal issues, assessing potential risks, safeguarding legal rights and interests, ensuring proper documentation, and guiding clients through the legal processes relevant to their matters.

What we offer

Legal advice and representation across eight practice areas.

Our practice encompasses a broad range of legal disciplines, including civil and commercial litigation, criminal litigation and defence, family law, co-operative housing society law, conveyancing and property documentation, banking and finance law, revenue and land laws, and employment and labour law.
